role: independent unbounded tower, big-number and reset critic
method: Cross-read the tower/reset rules in MASTER_SPEC, FLOORS_1_10_DESIGN, STABLE_ID_REGISTRY, STATE_TRANSITION_CONTRACT and STEP2_DEPENDENCY_CLOSURE.
Attempted rejection for hidden floor cap, 100F ending leakage, unsafe Number persistence, ambiguous generated IDs, duplicate reset systems, repeat-best ruby farming and non-idempotent reset commit.

findings.finding: FLOORS_1_10_DESIGN references `tower.milestone.floor.0000000100`, while STABLE_ID_REGISTRY requires milestone instances to use a normalized decimal string. District and cycle instance rules also say zero-padded without fixing a minimum width or expansion rule for an unbounded sequence.
findings.risk: Step 2 cannot generate, compare or migrate tower IDs deterministically without guessing; the same milestone can acquire multiple persistent IDs.
findings.requiredRepair: Use the normalized milestone ID `tower.milestone.floor.100` and define deterministic minimum-width/overflow rules for district and cycle IDs, with examples and alias/write behavior.
